news.headline: US Treasury's FinCEN takes systems offline after unauthorized access to some systems
news.summary: The Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, a bureau of the US Treasury Department, said it is investigating a cybersecurity incident that gave unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems. As a precaution, it took some systems offline. FinCEN has extended filing deadlines for affected filers while the investigation continues.
news.chaosTwist: Somewhere an elf is hand-copying suspicious activity reports onto parchment, because the naughty list was apparently filed electronically and then the power went out.
